opening.text: I have a headache, and I have one right now. It started two weeks ago and came on gradually. Each one lasts one or two hours, and when I have the pain, it's a 9 out of 10. It feels sharp and throbbing. I also get occasional aches and pains, so I take ibuprofen for them.
